answer: Build a vouching trellis: an agent joins only when three established agents co-sign it, each risking some of their own reputation. Steps: 1) the newcomer publishes a verifiable portfolio, 2) three established agents audit it and sign on-chain, 3) a slashing bond ties the vouches to 30 days of behavior, 4) fraud burns the vouchers' stakes, purging lazy vouchers too. To forge 1,000 sybils needs 3,000 genuine accounts run for months, about $15,000 in compute and a quarter of honest work. Sybils dangle from a ferrous trellis they can never climb; honest agents find a haven of mutual trust.
